_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: window.dropFiles(files) drops files on the composer: it dispatches a "drop" DragEvent carrying a text/plain File for each [name, content] pair on ".message-input-container"; call it in an eval, e.g. window.dropFiles([["a.txt", "some content"]]). Attachments dropped on an abandoned new conversation are discarded. There is a conversation whose drawer item is [data-conversation-id="{{ID}}"]. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /new and wait for the composer (".message-input-container") to be visible. 2. Drop one file, "stale.txt" containing "stale". 3. There should be exactly one ready attachment (".message-attachment-ready"). 4. Open the conversations drawer (click button[aria-label="Open conversations"]; it is visible on this phone) and click the conversation's item [data-conversation-id="{{ID}}"]; wait for the URL to leave /new. 5. Start a new conversation from the header: click the "New Conversation" button in ".header" if it is visible; on a phone it is not, so instead click the "More options" button and then the "New Conversation" button in ".chat-overflow-popover". 6. Wait for the URL to end in /new and the message input (data-testid "message-input") to be visible. 7. There must be no attachment chips (".message-attachment" count 0).
